mechanism: Asymmetric Thresholds: {{state}} change from A→B requires crossing threshold T_up. {{state}} change from B→A requires crossing lower threshold T_down. Gap between thresholds prevents oscillation near boundary. Thresholds fixed or adaptive. It uses a {{dampen}} effect on state transitions, requiring the signal to cross distinct upper and lower thresholds to switch modes.
failure_modes: Stuck {{state}}: Gap between thresholds is too wide, system never transitions back.

parameters.name: lower_threshold
parameters.description: Trigger to switch OFF, must be < upper
